displayName: Winter Rye Mulch Strip + Cucurbit (roller-crimped no-till)
benefit: Cereal rye drilled the previous fall and roller-crimped at anthesis produces a thick weed-suppressing mat for direct transplant or seed of warm-season cucurbits. Rodale Institute field trials show 60 to 80 percent weed reduction without herbicide.

members.title: Drill rye in fall, crimp at anthesis next May/June
members.body: Drill cereal rye at 150 lb per acre in early September. Roller-crimp when rye reaches anthesis (pollen shed). Transplant or no-till seed cucurbits through the crimped residue within 7 days.
